tables.name: trades
tables.description: Closed and open trade records — SSOT for all trading history. Every position opened by the bot is recorded here from open to close.

columns.name: strategy_id
columns.description: FK to strategies.id — which strategy triggered this trade

columns.name: exchange
columns.description: Exchange where trade was executed: okx, capital, alpaca

columns.name: asset_group
columns.description: Asset classification group (e.g. crypto_major, forex, indices)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Trade lifecycle status: open | closed | cancelled

columns.name: exit_ts
columns.description: Exit timestamp (Unix epoch seconds, null while open)

columns.name: fees_usd
columns.description: Total fees paid (entry + exit) in USD

columns.name: max_profit_pct
columns.description: Peak unrealized profit % during trade lifetime

columns.name: hold_seconds
columns.description: Duration trade was held in seconds

columns.name: entry_signal
columns.description: JSON snapshot of signal that triggered entry

columns.name: exit_type
columns.description: How trade was closed: tp | sl | trail | forced | manual | timeout

columns.name: regime
columns.description: Market regime at entry: RISK_ON | RISK_OFF | CHOPPY | TRANSITION | CRISIS

columns.name: tier
columns.description: Signal tier at entry: tier1 | tier2 | tier3

columns.name: providers
columns.description: JSON list/dict of signal providers contributing to entry verdict

columns.name: params_snapshot
columns.description: JSON snapshot of strategy params at entry time

columns.name: leverage
columns.description: Leverage multiplier used for this trade

columns.name: entry_fee
columns.description: Fee paid on entry in USD

columns.name: exit_fee
columns.description: Fee paid on exit in USD

columns.name: funding_paid
columns.description: Cumulative funding fees paid while position was open

columns.name: net_pnl_usd
columns.description: Net P&L after all fees (pnl_usd - fees_usd - funding_paid)

columns.name: entry_params
columns.description: JSON of entry-specific params (stop_pct, tp_pct, etc.)

readers: ops/param_governor.py — AI governor reviews trade outcomes

tables.name: trade_events
tables.description: Audit log of all lifecycle events for each trade (entry, SL hit, TP hit, trail updates, forced exits, etc.).

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Event type: entry | tp | sl | trail_update | forced | timeout | partial

writers: data/store.py:insert_trade_event (L503-L522) — called on every trade lifecycle transition

tables.name: signals
tables.description: All signals generated by the signal engine, with outcome linkage to trades. Primary source for signal quality analysis.

columns.name: ticker
columns.description: Asset ticker for which signal was generated

columns.name: factor_count
columns.description: Number of signal providers that contributed

columns.name: providers
columns.description: JSON list of signal provider names and scores

columns.name: acted_on
columns.description: 1 if this signal led to a trade entry, 0 otherwise

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Reason for not acting if acted_on=0 (e.g. regime_filter, cooldown)

writers: data/store.py:insert_signal (L258) — called by signal engine after scoring
readers: ai/feedback.py — AI learning from signal outcomes

tables.name: candidate_events
tables.description: Pre-signal candidates logged before full scoring. Records every asset considered by the scan engine, whether or not it passed to signal generation.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Scan event type (e.g. momentum, reversal, breakout)

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why candidate was or was not promoted

writers: data/store.py:log_candidate (L393) — explicit-column INSERT used by trade/pipeline reject sites (signal/entry_gate/ai_entry_judge) via log_candidate_event dict-form alias
data/store.py:log_candidate_event (L433) — dict-form wrapper for pipeline.py L213,345,413

tables.name: candles
tables.description: OHLCV candle data for all tracked tickers at multiple resolutions. Primary market data store for technical analysis.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Candle open timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

writers: data/lake.py:insert_candle (L58) — called by OKX/Binance websocket handlers

tables.name: funding_rates
tables.description: Perpetual futures funding rate history. Used for contrarian signal generation and position cost analysis.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Rate snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

tables.name: open_interest
tables.description: Open interest history for perp futures. Rising OI with price used as trend confirmation; extreme OI as contrarian indicator.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

columns.name: change_pct
columns.description: OI change percentage since previous snapshot

tables.name: ls_ratio
tables.description: Long/short ratio history for crypto perps. Extreme retail long bias → contrarian short signal; extreme short bias → contrarian long.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

columns.name: ratio
columns.description: Long/short ratio (> 1.0 means more longs than shorts)

tables.name: taker_volume
tables.description: Buy/sell taker volume history. Taker ratio (buy_vol / sell_vol) indicates aggressive buying or selling pressure.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

columns.name: buy_vol
columns.description: Taker buy volume in base currency

columns.name: sell_vol
columns.description: Taker sell volume in base currency

tables.name: sentiment
tables.description: Retail trader sentiment data (long/short %). Sourced from Capital.com/IG client sentiment and Myfxbook. Used for forex/indices contrarian signals.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

columns.name: long_pct
columns.description: Percentage of retail traders holding long (0–100)

columns.name: short_pct
columns.description: Percentage of retail traders holding short (0–100)

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: ig | myfxbook | capital | alpaca

tables.name: market_context
tables.description: Macro market context snapshots — Fear & Greed, BTC dominance, total market cap, volatility/trend z-scores, and current regime label.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Context snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, primary key)

columns.name: fear_greed
columns.description: CNN/Alternative.me Fear & Greed index (0=extreme fear, 100=extreme greed)

columns.name: total_mcap_b
columns.description: Total crypto market cap in billions USD

columns.name: btc_price
columns.description: BTC spot price in USD at snapshot time

columns.name: volatility_z
columns.description: Market volatility z-score (normalized vs rolling window)

columns.name: regime
columns.description: Detected regime: RISK_ON | RISK_OFF | CHOPPY | TRANSITION | CRISIS

tables.name: ai_calls
tables.description: Log of every AI API call made by the system. Tracks cost, latency, and outcome for budget management and AI ROI analysis.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Pipeline stage: entry | exit | regime | governor | feedback

columns.name: cost
columns.description: Cost in USD for this API call

columns.name: trade_id
columns.description: FK to trades.id if call was trade-related

columns.name: result
columns.description: JSON summary of AI decision output

writers: data/store.py:insert_ai_call (L308-L316) — called after every AI API response

tables.name: ai_decisions
tables.description: High-level AI trading decisions — action, confidence, and outcome linkage. Separate from ai_calls (which logs API mechanics); this logs business-level decisions.

columns.name: ticker
columns.description: Asset the decision was made for

columns.name: action
columns.description: AI recommended action: BUY | SELL | HOLD | SKIP

columns.name: models_used
columns.description: JSON list of models consulted for this decision

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.description: Total API cost for this decision in USD

columns.name: traded
columns.description: 1 if this decision resulted in a trade execution

columns.name: trade_pnl
columns.description: Outcome P&L from the trade this decision triggered

writers: ops/ai_controller.py:_bg (L297) — written after AI consensus is reached

tables.name: strategies
tables.description: Strategy definitions — parameters, applicability rules, fitness scores, and evolution lineage. Source of truth for all active and evolved strategies.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Strategy status: active | paused | retired | experimental

columns.name: match_groups
columns.description: JSON list of asset groups this strategy applies to

columns.name: entry_params
columns.description: JSON dict of entry parameters (score_threshold, min_strength, etc.)

columns.name: exit_params
columns.description: JSON dict of exit parameters (tp_pct, sl_pct, trail_pct, etc.)

columns.name: sizing_params
columns.description: JSON dict of position sizing parameters (base_pct, leverage, etc.)

columns.name: filter_params
columns.description: JSON dict of pre-entry filters (regime, time, volatility gates)

columns.name: bounds
columns.description: JSON dict of parameter evolution bounds for AI Governor

columns.name: parent_name
columns.description: Name of parent strategy this was evolved from

columns.name: fitness
columns.description: Fitness score (composite of win_rate, profit_factor, sharpe)

columns.name: trade_count
columns.description: Total trades executed under this strategy

tables.name: strategy_performance
tables.description: Materialized performance statistics per strategy × asset_group × direction × time_window. Refreshed hourly by hourly_stats tick.

columns.name: trade_count
columns.description: Number of closed trades in this window

columns.name: max_drawdown
columns.description: Maximum drawdown in this window (as negative %)

columns.name: avg_hold_sec
columns.description: Average trade hold time in seconds

readers: ops/param_governor.py — AI governor reads fitness metrics

tables.name: config_history
tables.description: Audit trail of all parameter changes. Every param_registry.set() call writes here with old/new values and reason.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Who made the change: ai_governor | param_registry | adaptive_tuner | manual

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Justification text from AI or system

writers: data/store.py:insert_config_change (L480) — called by param_registry on every set()

tables.name: ticker_stats
tables.description: Materialized per-ticker win rate and trade count. Refreshed hourly. Used for ticker blocking (repeated losers) and signal weighting.

columns.name: win_rate
columns.description: Historical win rate for this ticker (0.0–1.0)

columns.name: trade_count
columns.description: Total closed trades for this ticker

columns.name: blocked
columns.description: 1 if ticker is currently blocked from new entries

writers: ticks/hourly_stats.py:tick (L122) — hourly refresh from trades table
readers: ops/ticker_learner.py — ticker learning and block decisions

tables.name: hour_stats
tables.description: Materialized per-UTC-hour win rate. Used to detect low-quality trading hours. Refreshed hourly.

columns.name: win_rate
columns.description: Historical win rate for trades opened in this hour

columns.name: trade_count
columns.description: Total trades opened in this UTC hour

columns.name: blocked
columns.description: 1 if this hour is currently blocked (unused — hours always allowed per no_time_blocks rule)

writers: ticks/hourly_stats.py:tick (L107) — hourly refresh from trades table

tables.name: instrument_profiles
tables.description: Auto-learned exchange instrument metadata. Stores fee structures, leverage limits, min sizes, and trading hours per ticker. Updated by data_collector tick.

columns.name: exchange
columns.description: Exchange this profile is for: okx | capital | alpaca

columns.name: asset_type
columns.description: Asset type: crypto_swap | spot | forex | cfd | equity

columns.name: sector
columns.description: Market sector (e.g. DeFi, Layer1, Energy, Indices)

columns.name: market_cap_tier
columns.description: Market cap tier: large | mid | small | micro

columns.name: min_size
columns.description: Minimum order size in base currency

columns.name: min_stop
columns.description: Minimum stop loss distance as percentage

columns.name: leverage_max
columns.description: Maximum allowed leverage on this instrument

columns.name: trading_hours
columns.description: Trading hours: continuous | market_hours (JSON schedule for non-24/7)

writers: ticks/data_collector.py:_collect_profiles (L228, L252) — called by data_collector tick
readers: ai/context_builder.py (L81) — instrument context for AI decisions
trade/entry.py — fee and min_size validation before entry

tables.name: ticker_dynamics
tables.description: Time-series of per-ticker market dynamics — ATR, volatility, correlations, spread, and funding direction. Updated every candle_tech tick.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Computation timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

columns.name: atr_pct
columns.description: ATR as percentage of price (dynamic stop sizing input)

columns.name: liquidity_score
columns.description: Composite liquidity score (0.0–1.0) based on volume and spread

columns.name: funding_direction
columns.description: Net funding direction: positive (longs pay) | negative (shorts pay)

columns.name: corr_btc
columns.description: Price correlation with BTC (-1.0 to 1.0, 30d rolling)

columns.name: spread_pct
columns.description: Estimated bid-ask spread as percentage of price

writers: ticks/candle_tech.py:tick (L93) — computed from candles after each batch
readers: ai/context_builder.py (L97) — dynamic market context for AI

tables.name: ticker_performance
tables.description: Materialized per-ticker × direction × time_window performance statistics. More granular than ticker_stats. Used for optimal sizing and best-strategy routing.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: Direction: long | short (part of composite PK)

columns.name: time_window
columns.description: Analysis window: 7d | 30d | 90d | all (part of composite PK)

columns.name: trade_count
columns.description: Number of closed trades in this segment

columns.name: best_strategy
columns.description: Strategy ID with best performance for this ticker/direction

columns.name: worst_hour_utc
columns.description: UTC hour with worst historical performance

columns.name: best_hour_utc
columns.description: UTC hour with best historical performance

columns.name: streak
columns.description: Current win/loss streak (positive = wins, negative = losses)

columns.name: optimal_size_mult
columns.description: Recommended position size multiplier based on historical performance

writers: ticks/hourly_stats.py:tick (L145) — hourly refresh from trades table
readers: ai/context_builder.py (L114) — per-ticker context for AI decisions

tables.name: tick_snapshots
tables.description: High-frequency price and momentum snapshots for all active tickers. Updated every tick. Used for micro-momentum signals and spread estimation.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Snapshot timestamp (Unix epoch, part of composite PK)

columns.name: trend
columns.description: Short-term trend label: up | down | flat

readers: ticks/tick_snapshot.py (L40) — recent snapshot retrieval for momentum signals

tables.name: daily_summary
tables.description: Daily aggregated metrics (PnL, trade count, win rate, fees, etc.) stored as key-value pairs. Used for daily reporting and trend analysis.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Date string YYYY-MM-DD (part of composite PK)

columns.name: metric
columns.description: Metric name (e.g. pnl_usd, trade_count, win_rate) — part of composite PK

writers: data/store.py — daily summary refresh (called by hourly_stats)

tables.name: market_snapshots
tables.description: Combined per-ticker market data snapshots aggregating price, funding, L/S ratio, OI, and fear/greed into a single row per (ts, ticker). Legacy denormalized format.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Snapshot timestamp string (part of composite PK)

columns.name: fear_greed
columns.description: Fear & Greed index value at snapshot time

tables.name: signal_outcomes
tables.description: Signal-to-outcome tracking: records whether a signal was acted on and what P&L resulted. Used for signal quality learning.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Signal timestamp string (part of composite PK)

columns.name: entered
columns.description: 1 if trade was entered, 0 if filtered

columns.name: pnl_pct
columns.description: Resulting trade P&L % (null if not entered or still open)

writers: data/store.py — signal outcome update after trade close

tables.name: strategy_map
tables.description: Lookup table mapping strategy names to short display codes. Used purely for dashboard display and logging brevity.

columns.name: short_code
columns.description: Short display code for dashboard (e.g. CM, FX, MR)

tables.name: _meta
tables.description: Internal system metadata key-value store. Holds session state, last-run timestamps, and system flags.

tables.name: _schema_version
tables.description: Schema version tracking. Prevents duplicate migrations on restart.

columns.name: version
columns.description: Current schema version integer (10 as of 2026-04-08)
